reasoning_text:
We need to analyze conceptual meaning of each couplet (though they seem not proper Persian). Determine which one differs in concept/message from others.

Let's translate roughly.

1. "حسن و جمال دلکش دلدار بنگرید - از پای تا به سر همگی دیده ها شوید" => "Observe the charming beauty of the beloved - from foot to head all eyes become (something)". Concept: praising beauty of beloved, visual admiration.

2. "عجایب نقش ها سازی سوی خاک - فروغ رویت اندازی سمت خاک" => "Wonders of the images you make towards the earth - the radiance of your face directed towards the earth". Could be about humility, turning beauty to earth? Might be about creation, perhaps praising the beloved's image and its effect on earth.

3. "از آنش رنگ های بی شمار است - گل از شوق

... "از آنش رنگ های بی شمار است - گل از شوق تو خندان در بهار است" => "From it there are countless colors - the flower smiles in spring from your longing". Concept: abundance of colors, spring, love.

4. "از پای تا به سر همه سمع و بصر شدم - تا رفتن

... "از پای تا به سر همه سمع و بصر شدم - تا رفتنش ببینم و گفتارش بنگرم" => "From foot to head I became all hearing and sight - so that I may see his departure and watch his speech". Concept: becoming all senses to observe departure and speech.

All seem about perception of beloved. Which one differs? Maybe #2 mentions "soil/earth" (خاک) and "radiance of your face towards earth" which is more about humility or mortality, while others focus on beauty, colors, senses. #2 seems about creation or transformation of earth, maybe different concept.

Alternatively #4 mentions hearing and sight, focusing on senses rather than visual beauty. But #1 also about eyes. #3 about colors and spring. #2 about "soil" maybe about death or burial.

Thus outlier likely #2.

Return number 2.
